text:
jordan: Hey team — quick sync on the BridgeWorks launch playbook. Need interview notes, two customer quotes (short + long), legal clearance, and a callout for the benchmark numbers to be included in the blog. Target publish: next Wed. Can we lock this down by EOD Friday?

eva: Got it. I can run the interview Wed morning. Who's interviewing?
mike: I can do the interview — will prep a short guide. Want the messaging to lead with reliability + 3x latency improvement from our routing changes.

li: Heads-up from sales: BridgeWorks inbound interest is already heating up. Routing ask — please add a ‘post-publish’ routing rule so MQLs from the blog hit unicorn-sales@ and the AE queue.

jordan: @li good call. Add to the publish checklist. Also want a webinar hook — 20-min demo + 10-min q&a the week after publish. Sam can run registration?
sam: Yup. I can create the registration page and promo copy. Need the blog slug and hero quote first.

mike: Draft quote options: 1) "Redwood cut inference latency in half for our conversational endpoints" (short) 2) longer: "By moving to Redwood's dedicated routing and KV cache we saw 3x faster p99 latencies and a predictable cost drop — that made the feature viable for millions of users." Thoughts?
karla: Those sound fine but legal needs a fact-check on the numbers and permission to use product names. Please add a link to the signed NDA and the interview consent doc.

legal-bot: New doc uploaded: https://drive.redwood.work/BridgeWorks/consent-and-nda-v2.pdf (viewer only)

mike: Will include the consent link in the interview brief. Quick Q: do we have the benchmark artifact (end-to-end run) we can attach to the blog?
eva: Ops exported the benchmark CSV last night and dropped it in /mnt/releases/benchmarks/bridgeworks-2026-03.csv — I'll attach a sanitized snapshot.

karla: FYI — remove any pricing/contract-specific figures from the public copy. Also, reword "millions of users" to "large-scale production users" unless BridgeWorks confirms the exact number.

jordan: Good catch. Mike — change phrasing to "large-scale production users" for the blog draft and keep the specific number for the gated benchmark pdf.

mike: Will do. Interview brief below (short):
```
Interviewer: Mike
Length: 25 min
Goals: capture customer's problem, what they measured, the model+infrastructure config, top 2–3 impact metrics, and a short soundbite for hero.
Top questions:
  - What was the user problem you were solving?
  - Which model and config were you serving?
  - What metrics moved (latency/cost/throughput)?
  - Can you provide a 1–2 sentence hero quote?
  - Any blockers or funny stories?
```

eva: Perfect. I'll send the calendar invite and prep the recording link. Please add the BridgeWorks PR contact to the invite for quote approvals.

li: I'll DM the PR contact and ask for an approved hero quote by Monday so Sam can start the webinar page.

karla: Once I get the interview transcript and the numeric artifact, I can do a legal sign-off check. Timeline looks tight but feasible.

mike: Plan for two quote versions in the doc (short + long). Tag the short one as "hero" and confirm approval with BridgeWorks during the call.

jordan: Operational checklist (quick):
- interview scheduled (eva/mike)
- consent doc signed (bridgeworks)
- quotes captured and flagged hero/long (mike)
- legal sign-off on text + numbers (karla)
- publish checklist updated with inbound routing rule (li)
- webinar registration page live (sam)
- gated benchmark pdf attached to blog for verified numbers (eva)

eva: I'll update the shared checklist in Google Sheets and ping everyone when done.
sam: I'll draft the registration and promo copy once I get the hero quote. Estimated publish promo send: Day of publish + 2 reminder emails.

publish-bot: Scheduled post slot reserved: 2026-03-31 09:00 PT — pending final review and legal sign-off. :calendar:

mike: One more ask — can we include a small technical appendix with the perf test commands? Something like:
```
# perf script skeleton
./run_benchmark --model redwood-v1 --seq 2048 --batch 8 --warmup 100 --samples 1000 > results.json
```
Karla — confirm no IP leakage and we can publish sanitized command lines.

karla: That command is fine to publish once we strip internal flags and dataset names. I'll review the appendix draft.

jordan: Thanks all — checkpoint Friday EOD. If we have legal sign-off, Sam will flip the publish switch and Li will confirm inbound routing. :thumbsup:

li: Got it. I'll be on standby for routing rules and AE handoff.

mike: I'll post the draft blog and the two quote options in the doc by tomorrow afternoon.

karla: I'll aim to complete legal review by Friday 4pm PT.

end of thread.
